name: affine-connector
description: AFFiNE workspace workflows for ChatGPT through the shared Bratonien MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Read, search and edit a self-hosted AFFiNE workspace through Bratonien MCP.
interface.longDescription: Bridges the native AFFiNE workspace MCP into the shared Bratonien MCP server. Tool schemas and effective document permissions remain owned by AFFiNE; the connector dynamically exposes AFFiNE's native read, search and write tools under the affine namespace.
defaultPrompt: Update this AFFiNE document for me.
